value.rationale: Algebra retracts are invariant splitting subalgebras. The minimal nonabelian modular group algebra comparison gains an explicit structural separator: Q8 is retract-rigid while D8 has 2q^4 embedded dual-number retracts and 2q^5 splitting maps. The full map-by-rank polynomial for all characteristic-two finite fields distinguishes the pair beyond their already-known nonisomorphism; unlike an arbitrary small numerical census it has a uniform parameter and a precise natural invariant.
